issues.description: The UML in the problem statement shows Animal.messageOnFeed() as public (plus sign) while the solution implements it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This creates a visibility mismatch: the specification implies a public abstract method, but the reference implementation restricts it to protected. Students may be confused about the intended visibility and whether they should declare messageOnFeed() as public or protected.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method visibility consistent. Either change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to public abstract String messageOnFeed() to match the UML/specification, or update the UML/problem statement to indicate protected visibility. Preferably declare the method public abstract to clearly match the UML and typical interface expectations.
